name: Del Amo Fashion Center
summary: Large mall offers trendy retailers, restaurants & a theater, plus a garden-inspired dining pavilion.
description: Del Amo Fashion Center is one of the largest shopping destinations on the West Coast, offering an exceptional retail experience with premium department stores and over 200 specialty shops. This Simon Property features an impressive mix of fashion, dining, and entertainment options in a modern, multi-level enclosed environment. Located in the heart of the South Bay, it serves as the premier shopping destination for the greater Los Angeles area.
demographics: Del Amo Fashion Center attracts a diverse, affluent South Bay demographic with median household incomes above the regional average, drawing heavily from families and professionals aged 25-54 in Torrance, Redondo Beach, and surrounding communities. The trade area encompasses upwardly mobile suburban households with strong purchasing power, including a significant Asian-American population reflective of the South Bay's demographic composition. Shoppers typically seek a mix of premium brands and mainstream retailers, with weekend visits being family-oriented and weekday traffic skewing toward professionals and retirees seeking both shopping and dining experiences.
